headline: Result Update

highlights: 06 November 2026 CMP*: ₹1,544/- Sector – Chemicals Deepak Nitrite Ltd – Q2FY27 1 Result Update Q2FY27 Deepak Nitrite Ltd Important Data During Q2FY27, the company reported strong revenue growth of 62% YoY and 19% QoQ to ₹3,076crs.
EBITDA increased 207% YoY and 16% QoQ to ₹627crs, with EBITDA margin improving to 20% from 11% in Q2FY26, while moderating from 21% in Q1FY27.
PAT grew 235% YoY and 15% QoQ to ₹398crs, supported by strong operating performance.
However, Advanced Intermediates continued to face margin pressure due to aggressive global pricing, higher raw material, energy and freight costs.
valuation: New capacities – Commissioning and ramp-up • The chlorination, photochlorination and specialty chemicals facilities at Dahej, involving an investment of approximately ₹300crs, have been commissioned. • These facilities are designed to handle multiple products and applications, including agrochemicals, electronic chemicals, solvents and personal care, reducing dependence on individual customer campaigns.

Management indicated that the plants are operating at or above targeted efficiencies and utilisation can be increased to 100% at short notice, depending on market demand and profitability. • REACH registrations have been obtained for MIBK/MIBC, opening up export opportunities, particularly in Europe for frothing agents and mining chemicals.
watch: Post the better-than-expected Q2FY27 results, we have factored in the improved earnings outlook and revised upwards our FY27 revenue/EBITDA/PAT estimates by 22%/41%/52% and FY28 estimates by 25%/45%/56%, respectively.
